meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704, Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough, Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Renaud Capuçon, Gerard Causse, Iddo Bar-Shai & Jean-Jacques Kantorow, Martha Argerich, Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
